theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η
